+#!/usr/bin/python
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: netapp_e_drive_firmware
+short_description: Manage NetApp E-Series drive firmware
+version_added: '2.10'
+description:
+  - Upload drive firmware and upgrade compatible drives that are not already at the target version.
+  - Drive firmware must be obtained from NetApp support.
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - netapp.eseries
+options:
+  firmware:
+    description: Paths to E-Series drive firmware files on the controller host.
+    required: true
+    type: list
+    elements: path
+  wait_for_completion:
+    description: Wait until all selected drives have finished upgrading.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+    description: Skip offline or unavailable drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade drives while they accept I/O.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Upgrade drive firmware
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:
+    ssid: "1"
+    api_url: https://array.example.com:8443
+    api_username: admin
+    api_password: secret
+    firmware:
+      - /srv/firmware/drive.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: true
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+upgrade_in_process:
+  description: Whether the requested upgrade is still running.
+  returned: always
+  type: bool
+'''
+
+import os
+import time
+
+from ansible.module_utils._text import to_native
+from ansible.module_utils.netapp import NetAppESeriesModule, create_multipart_formdata
+
+WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
+POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 5
+
+
+class NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware(NetAppESeriesModule):
+    def __init__(self):
+        options = dict(firmware=dict(type='list', elements='path', required=True),
+                       wait_for_completion=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+                       ignore_inaccessible_drives=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+                       upgrade_drives_online=dict(type='bool', default=True))
+        super(NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware, self).__init__(options, supports_check_mode=True)
+        self.firmware_list = self.module.params['firmware']
+        self.wait_for_completion = self.module.params['wait_for_completion']
+        self.ignore_inaccessible_drives = self.module.params['ignore_inaccessible_drives']
+        self.upgrade_drives_online = self.module.params['upgrade_drives_online']
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+        self._upgrade_list = None
+
+    def _path(self, suffix):
+        return 'storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives%s' % (self.ssid, suffix)
+
+    def upload_firmware(self):
+        if self.module.check_mode:
+            return
+        for path in self.firmware_list:
+            try:
+                headers, data = create_multipart_formdata([('file', os.path.basename(path), path)])
+                self.request('files/drive', method='POST', headers=headers, data=data)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upload drive firmware %s to array %s: %s' %
+                                      (path, self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+    def upgrade_list(self):
+        if self._upgrade_list is not None:
+            return self._upgrade_list
+        try:
+            _, compatibilities = self.request(self._path(''))
+            _, health = self.request('storage-systems/%s/drives' % self.ssid)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        if isinstance(compatibilities, dict):
+            compatibilities = compatibilities.get('compatibilities', compatibilities.get('driveFirmware', []))
+        if isinstance(health, dict):
+            health = health.get('drives', [])
+        drives = {drive['driveRef']: drive for drive in health}
+        result = []
+        for path in self.firmware_list:
+            filename = os.path.basename(path)
+            refs = []
+            for item in compatibilities:
+                if os.path.basename(item.get('filename', '')) != filename:
+                    continue
+                for ref in item.get('driveRefList', []):
+                    try:
+                        drive = drives[ref]
+                        if drive.get('status', drive.get('driveStatus', 'optimal')).lower() in ('offline', 'unavailable'):
+                            if self.ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+                                continue
+                            self.module.fail_json(msg='Inaccessible drive %s on array %s.' % (ref, self.ssid))
+                        if drive.get('firmwareVersion') == item.get('firmwareVersion'):
+                            continue
+                        if self.upgrade_drives_online and not item.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', True):
+                            self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Drive %s on array %s.' %
+                                                  (ref, self.ssid))
+                        refs.append(ref)
+                    except KeyError as error:
+                        self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array %s: %s' %
+                                              (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+            if refs:
+                result.append(dict(filename=filename, driveRefList=refs))
+        self._upgrade_list = result
+        return result
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        targets = {ref for item in self.upgrade_list() for ref in item['driveRefList']}
+        deadline = time.time() + WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while True:
+            try:
+                _, states = self.request(self._path('/state'))
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+            if isinstance(states, dict):
+                states = states.get('driveStates', [])
+            found = set()
+            for state in states:
+                ref = state.get('driveRef')
+                if ref not in targets:
+                    continue
+                found.add(ref)
+                status = state.get('status')
+                if status not in ('okay', 'inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted'):
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Drive %s status %s.' % (ref, status))
+            if found == targets and all(state.get('status') == 'okay' for state in states
+                                        if state.get('driveRef') in targets):
+                self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+                return
+            if time.time() >= deadline:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array %s.' % self.ssid)
+            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        try:
+            self.request(self._path('/initiate-upgrade'), method='POST',
+                         data=dict(upgradeDrivesOnline=self.upgrade_drives_online,
+                                   firmware=self.upgrade_list()))
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
